Senior Cloud Developer “SURU WaterMonitor Business” (f/m/d)

Are you a passionate cloud engineer ready to shape modern cloud-native applications and take end-to-end technical ownership? To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Senior Cloud Developer (m/f/d) for our Value Stream “SURU WaterMonitor Business” at the earliest possible opportunity.

As a Senior Cloud Developer for our Value Stream “SURU WaterMonitor Business”, you will design, build, and operate modern cloud-native applications that are part of SURU´s product portfolio. Working closely with Product Management, Data & Analytics, Operations, Sales, and external partners, you will turn business requirements into scalable, secure, and reliable software solutions that create measurable customer value. You will take ownership of features throughout their entire lifecycle, from architecture and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Using AWS and modern web technologies, you will help deliver software that is reliable, easy to operate, and built to scale.

Key Responsibilities:

- Design, develop, and operate modern cloud-native applications using TypeScript, NestJS, Next.js, and AWS (including** Lambda, DynamoDB, ECS, and CDK**)
- Build full-stack solutions, encompassing backend services, APIs, user-facing frontend applications, and integrations with internal and external systems
- Collaborate cross-functionally with product and business teams to turn ideas into well-designed, scalable technical architectures
- Take end-to-end ownership of features across their entire lifecycle, from initial design discussions through deployment and production monitoring
- Drive technical leadership** **by shaping architecture decisions, performing code reviews, mentoring team members, and maintaining high engineering standards
- Champion modern engineering practices, promoting clean code, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and the effective use of AI-assisted development tools

Job Requirements:

- University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a similar qualification
- 5+ years of professional experience in software development, cloud platforms, or IoT solutions
- Strong experience with** TypeScript**, ideally including NestJS and Next.js
- Experience designing, building, and operating AWS-based cloud applications
- Solid understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, and cloud-native application design
- Experience with automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, and modern DevOps practices.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Ahands-on mindset with strong ownership and a focus on delivering high-quality software
- Experience using AI-assisted engineering practices to improve development efficiency and quality
- Proficiency in both English and German (German at least B1)
- Nice to Have:Experience with IoT platforms, event-driven architectures, connectivity technologies, infrastructure automation, observability, or industrial data environments. AWS certification (e.g. AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Developer) is a plus

What´s In It For You:

- Small, agile teams where your work and voice have real impact
- A dynamic, fast-moving company where things actually get built and shipped
- A lot of freedom in how you approach your work and solve problems
- Support for attending conferences to keep learning and stay connected to the widerengineering community.

Why Join SURU?

A pipe-related water damage incident happens every 30 seconds in Germany alone. At SURU - part ofLIXIL - you´ll build the smart metering and leak-detection software that helps utilities, insurers, andhomeowners catch these problems before they become costly disasters, protecting both buildings andone of the world´s most precious resources. You will work on modern cloud technologies, takeownership of your work, and have the opportunity to influence architecture, engineering practices, andthe direction of the platform while working as part of a collaborative team.the direction of the platform while working as part of a collaborative team.

We are the perfect match if...

- Your job is your passion and you feel "Pure Freude an Wasser" just like us
- You appreciate a respectful environment
- You like to break new ground and keep learning
- You always try to do the right thing

Are we on the same wavelength? We are looking forward to your application!

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Program Lead Finance (f/m/d), you lead the Finance transformation for Large Steam & Syncons (LSS) while serving as co-lead of the overall LSS rollout within Siemens Energy's global S4Energy program.
In this project-driven Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business, you act as the key Finance & Controlling representative, ensuring that business requirements are translated into scalable SAP S/4HANA solutions. Working closely with Finance, Controlling, Manufacturing, and global program teams, you steer critical decisions across project controlling, product costing, manufacturing controlling, and financial closing.
From shaping target processes and driving testing activities to coordinating cutover, go-live, and change management, you combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution to deliver a successful and sustainable business transformation.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the Finance transformation and co-lead the S4Energy rollout for Large Steam & Syncons, ensuring alignment across stakeholders and program objectives
* Drive end-to-end Finance implementation activities, including requirements management, process design, Fit-Gap workshops, testing, data migration, cutover, go-live, and hypercare
* Harmonize Finance & Controlling processes by balancing business requirements with SAP S/4HANA standards and scalable best practices
* Coordinate cross-functional rollout activities and manage dependencies across Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and IT
* Build and leverage a global Siemens Energy transformation network to share best practices and accelerate implementation success
* Lead stakeholder engagement and change management initiatives to ensure organizational readiness and sustainable adoption

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field
* Extensive experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance & Controlling, including leading complex implementation and business transformation programs
* Strong expertise in Record-to-Report, Project Controlling, Product Costing, Manufacturing Controlling, and Financial Closing
* Solid understanding of Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business processes and end-to-end value flows across project execution and manufacturing
* Excellent stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and leadership skills with experience aligning global cross-functional teams
* Fluency in German and English, enabling effective collaboration in an international environment

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Process Operator (f/m/d)

Place of work: Production site, near Chemnitz, Germany
Start date: ASAP
Contract type: Full-time

About us

We’re on a mission to revolutionize how the world produces protein and we’re just getting started.

Pacifico is a Leipzig-based biotech company producing the world’s most cost-competitive texturized protein through fermentation. Our technology makes sustainable, high-quality protein cheaper than conventional meat production – not just better for the planet, but better for you.

Our production site near Chemnitz is where science meets scale: industrial fermentation systems, food-grade processing lines, and a team that moves fast. We’re now looking for a Process Operator (f/m/d) to support the day-to-day facility operations at our production site.

The role

In this role, you will support the operations of our fermentation facility and all related processing steps. You will work closely with a Senior Process Lead and will be trained on our equipment, processes, and quality standards.

The role is strongly hands-on and operational, with a focus on running equipment, preparing materials, and supporting production. Working hours are initially within typical daytime working hours; as production scales, openness to late and occasional weekend shifts is valued.

Your main tasks

- Preparation of fermentation media (weighing, mixing, heating, handling raw materials)
- Operating fermentation tanks and auxiliary equipment
- Supporting downstream processing (emptying tanks, handling and processing biomass)
- Operating our food processing line and its associated equipment
- Monitoring basic process parameters (e.g. temperature, time, filling levels)
- Cleaning and sanitising equipment (CIP systems and manual cleaning)
- Maintaining cleanliness, order, and safety in the facility
- Documenting basic production activities and flagging issues when they arise

Your profile

- Practical experience in food & beverage or similar manufacturing environments
- Comfortable working in a production setting with physical tasks and machinery
- Careful, reliable, and quality-oriented working style
- Interest in food production and fermentation processes
- Ability to work well in a small team and communicate clearly on the shop floor
- Basic working knowledge of English

Nice to have

- Experience in a brewery, dairy or fermentation-based production
- Technical or vocational training in a relevant field
- Familiarity with hygiene standards and food safety practices
- Experience with CIP systems or industrial cleaning routines
- Basic working knowledge of German

What we offer

- A full-time role with clear responsibilities and growth opportunities
- 28 days of paid holiday per year
- Subsidy for the Germany Ticket (“Deutschland-Ticket”)
- Hands-on training and close collaboration with experienced colleagues

How to apply

A short CV/brief overview of your previous work experience is sufficient.

A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials at the interface between materials science and synthetic biology, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. The multidisciplinary component of our research requires intensive information and data exchange between multiple disciplines. We work on semantically structured data and interfaces, AI-driven workflows, and contribute to engaging the growing ELM community in digitalized research.

To support the digitalization of SynBio work within the context of ELM development, we are seeking a

Postdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Synthetic Biology (f/m/d)

and interest in data-driven research. The position is integrated in the collaborative network MaterialVital Hub, recently funded by the Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space (BMFTR) in collaboration with the Galaxy Community Hub. The candidate will be part of a team of experimental scientists and research data management experts at INM-Leibniz Institute for New Materials and Bioinformaticians at the University of Freiburg.

Your roles:

- Contribute to the digitalization of synthetic biology workflows for ELM development in collaboration with SynBio researchers at INM.
- Develop metadata schemas for typical synthetic biology steps and methodologies in ELM research which are transferable to electronic LabBooks and data platforms of relevance for other researchers within the MaterialVital Hub.
- Contribute to the development of an ELM-dedicated ontology for interoperability within the MaterialVital Hub in cooperation with MaterialDigital Platform partners and the Galaxy Community Hub.
- Support and promote digitalization of the ELM community within the MaterialVital Hub in close interaction with Galaxi Community Hub and MaterialDigital Platform and NFDI.
- Attend workshops and disseminate your work within the ELM community by presenting at conferences and scientific events.
- Document your work and report to project coordinators and stakeholders.

Your profile:

- PhD degree in synthetic biology, biotechnology or related disciplines.
- Experience as experimental researcher in combination with modelling or data-driven methods is ideal. Previous experience as data steward, or previous work within NFDI Consortia is of advantage. Knowledge in automated workflows for SynBio research is advantageous.
- Interest in working with and for the digitalization of the ELM community.
- Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills.
- Very good communication skills in English.

We offer:

- An emergent research topic with multiple opportunities to contribute and interact with the growing community and contribute to its development at an early stage.
- Direct access to and high visibility in the SynBio and ELM networks at national and international level.
- An existing team with expertise and drive to move forward digitalization in ELM research. A well-structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities.
- A community-oriented, multifaceted work with great scope for creativity.
- A highly professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture.
- Strong support of training and career development towards an outstanding profile as data scientist in synthetic biology research.
- Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunity.
- A family-friendly working place.
- A EG 13 TV-L position (full time). A part time position is also possible.

The position is initially for 3 years.

Interested?

We look forward to your application! Please upload your CV and motivation letter, by**_ September 15th, 2026 _**via the online application system. For further information on this position, please contact INM Scientific Director Prof. Dr. Aránzazu del Campo (aranzazu.delcampo@leibniz-inm.de ).

The INM practices an open and appreciative corporate culture in which the existing diversity is promoted and lived. The institute is an equal opportunity employer with a certified family-friendly policy, and it provides offers for a better work-life balance, flextime, and mobile working. We promote professional opportunities for women and strongly encourage them to apply. Full time jobs can be generally divided. Severely disabled applicants with equal qualifications and aptitude will be given preferential consideration.

Why Löwenstein Medical?

What you do here makes a difference.
For 40 years, we have been developing and manufacturing medical technology that saves lives and improves quality of life. Around the world, our products and services support patients who depend on reliable respiratory care, helping them regain greater independence and well-being. Thanks to the dedication of our employees across all areas of the company, we have become one of the leading providers of medical technology solutions for hospital and homecare settings. Work where your contribution matters.
No matter what role you take on at Löwenstein Medical, your work helps make high-quality healthcare possible and contributes to improving the lives of patients every day.

Key Responsibilities

- Coordinate, support, and execute international sleep diagnostics projects from procurement planning through to routine operation, serving both B2B and B2C customers in close collaboration with the International Homecare Sales Team.
- Support and oversee product evaluations, pilot projects, and test installations at customer sites.
- Plan, organize, and deliver customer training sessions, workshops, and educational events.
- Develop and implement sleep diagnostics concepts for new international markets in cooperation with the International Homecare Sales Team.
- Manage and develop relationships with existing international customers, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
- Provide and coordinate first- and second-level technical support for customers and partners.
- Prepare and deliver product presentations, demonstrations, and training sessions for international audiences.
- Plan, coordinate, and participate in international trade fairs, congresses, and industry conferences.
- Collect and analyze market-specific product requirements and customer needs and systematically communicate findings to the Product Development team.
- Gather marketing-related requirements and market insights from international regions and coordinate their implementation with the Marketing team.
- Monitor market trends, emerging technologies, and new product developments in the field of sleep diagnostics and homecare.
- Analyze and track competitor activities, products, and market strategies.
- Prepare regular reports and business updates for the company headquarters in Germany

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree (or comparable education) in Medical Technology, Biomedical Engineering, or a comparable field.
- Proven experience working in an international environment within the medical technology industry.
- Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable: sleep diagnostics, sleep apnea therapy, respiratory care, or neurophysiology.
- Strong intercultural competence with the ability to adapt to diverse cultures, working styles, and business environments.
- Flexibility regarding working hours to support international operations and customer needs.
- Excellent command of English, with strong verbal and written communication skills.
- Highly self-motivated with a proactive, solution-oriented, and independent approach to work.
- Willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis.
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build and maintain professional relationships.
- Sound knowledge of IT systems, networking technologies, and medical/anatomical concepts related to sleep diagnostics and homecare applications.
- Confident and professional presenter with experience delivering product demonstrations, customer training, and educational workshops.

What we offer

- A secure position with a leading family-owned medical technology company
- Comprehensive onboarding and individual training opportunities
- Flexible working hours and attractive work-life balance options
- A collaborative working environment with short decision-making processes
- Long-term career development opportunities
- The opportunity to contribute to improving patients' quality of life every day

Ready to make a difference?

As an independent family-owned business, we stand for stability, reliability, and a long-term perspective. We finance our growth through our own resources and focus on sustainable success rather than short-term profit targets. Family values, mutual respect, and a collaborative working environment are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that lasting success is achieved through strong teams and people who take ownership, act responsibly, and support one another. If these values resonate with you, we would be delighted to hear from you. We look forward to receiving your application.

The Leibniz-IPHT is a university independent research institute with close connection to the Friedrich-Schiller-University Jena (https://www.uni-jena.de/en) and member of the Leibniz association (https://www.leibniz-gemeinschaft.de/en/institutes/leibniz-institutes-all-lists) .

Job description:

The PhD candidate is expected to join us to work on the research project “Light-driven microdrones”, which is based on the collaboration between Dr. Xiaofei Wu at Leibniz-IPHT and Prof. Bert Hecht at University of Würzburg. Light-driven microdrones are micrometer-sized robots actuated by multiple independent optical nanomotors, which generate thrusts upon light illumination. Up to date, we have developed microdrones working in a plane with full and independent controls in all 3 degrees of freedom of 2D motions, which is a breakthrough for light-driven robotic devices (see https://communities.springernature.com/posts/light-driven-microdrones-a-new-level-of-optical-manipulation).

We are now aiming to extend the operation space of the microdrones to 3D. The two PhD candidates at Leibniz-IPHT and University of Würzburg will work together to achieve this goal by fulfilling a few challenging tasks. Once the whole microdrone system is established, we will perform experiments to showcase the great potential of the microdrones for future applications. The current idea is to do tip-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (TERS) of cells or similar specimens.

Your field of activity includes:

- Use numerical simulations (FDTD, COMSOL, deep learning) to design efficient nanomotors of the microdrones for 3D control
- Develop microfluidic chips as experimental platform of the microdrones. Fabricate the microfluidic chips using photolithography and 3D nano/microprinting (e.g. Nanoscribe).
- Contribute to fabrications of the microdrones using FIB, EBL, transfer, etc.
- Conduct the experiments of TERS on biological specimens

Desired skills and abilities

- Strong problem-solving drive and ambition for excellence
- Solid knowledge in electromagnetics and optics

- Experience in programming (Python, Matlab, etc.) is a plus
- Experience in micro/nanofabrication is a plus
- Good communication skills in English (spoken and written)
- Independence, responsibility and team player

We offer:

- An open welcoming culture and an inclusive and interdisciplinary working environment: Located on the Beutenberg campus in Jena, Leibniz-IPHT is home to more than 400 employees from around the world working at the interface of physics, biochemistry, technology, data science and medicine to develop the photonic technologies of tomorrow.
- World-class equipment and facilities: Leibniz-IPHT has a large number of physics, chemistry and biology laboratories at the highest level. It also has state-of-the-art fiber drawing and clean room facilities (including lithography facilities) as well as microfluidics fabrication and big data computing facilities.
- Thorough and comprehensive personal training: Transferring good practices in scientific working and outreach is one of our main focus points. In a respectful and appreciative environment, you will learn everything you need for a career inside and outside of science. Moreover, plenty of workshops and opportunities for scientific exchange are offered by the Leibniz IPHT, as well as the Abbe School of Photonics and the Graduate Academy of the Friedrich-Schiller University Jena.
- A family-friendly working environment with support offers for the compatibility of family and work (e.g. parent-child office, campus kindergarten places, advice on family care situations from trained care guides and much more).
- Flexible working time models as well as 30 days vacation/year, special annual payment and bridge days.

- 
Generation and expansion of hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) &

- 
Translation control in the hematopoietic system

Operational area: Institute of Transfusion Medicine and Cellular Therapeutics

Working hours: 65% of the collectively agreed full-time working hours (currently 38.5 hours per week)

Duration/Term of employment: Initially limited to 3 years. The position offers the opportunity to pursue a doctoral degree

Start date: As soon as possible

Remuneration/Rates: EG 13 (TV-L)

Why you should choose us?

We offer…

- 30 days of vacation per year for full-time employment
- A bonus of 3,000 euros for employees who help recruit employees in different sectors
- An attractive company pension scheme from VBL
- Education opportunities, including updating and upgrading
- Access to public transport
- In-house kindergarten (places subject to availability)
- Staff residences (places subject to availability and by arrangement)
- An onboarding app for new employees
- Extended opening hours in the staff restaurant

Description

At the Institute of Transfusion Medicine and Cellular Therapeutics (Director: Univ.-Prof. Dr. Hannes Klump) we investigate mRNA-based reprogramming hematopoietic cells. Our aims are to generate and expand hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) and to produce novel cellular therapeutics for patient care. We further investigate the regulation of translation in resting HSCs and during their differentiation into the hematopoietic lineages, as well as stimulation-induced changes to translation in mature hematopoietic cells. Our aim is to gain unprecedented and molecular insight into the underlying genetic programs and mechanisms and to leverage this understanding for the generation of novel therapeutic approaches.

In close collaboration with our research partners, we employ multidisciplinary approaches combining chemical synthesis, cell biology, molecular genetics, and biochemistry. We further offer an outstanding, international research environment with state-of-the-art facilities located in a newly constructed building that houses spacious clean rooms.

Your profile

- We are seeking strong candidates with a master’s degree in biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, or a related field with excellent academic records. Applicants should bring experience in molecular biology and the culture of human cells; experience in flow cytometry is a plus. Excellent communication skills and proficiency in the English language (Level C1), both written and spoken, are required.
- We offer close mentorship by experienced researchers and a vibrant working environment that fosters innovation and interdisciplinary collaboration for academic and professional growth
